name: PZM21
summary: PZM21 is an experimental opioid analgesic drug that is being researched for the treatment of pain.

pharmacology.text: It is claimed to be a functionally selective μ-opioid receptor agonist which produces μ-opioid receptor mediated G protein signaling, with potency and efficacy similar to morphine, but with less β-arrestin 2 recruitment.

uses.text: PZM21 is an experimental opioid analgesic drug that is being researched for the treatment of pain.

sideEffects.text: More recent research has suggested however that at higher doses, PZM21 is capable of producing classic opioid side effects such as respiratory depression and development of tolerance and may have only limited functional selectivity.
